newsitem.title: POLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - ING Barings rates Rolimpex "hold".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ING Barings rates Rolimpex "hold".

text.p: Investors should hold shares in Polish food trader and producer Rolimpex SA, whose consolidated earnings before exceptionals are seen flat this year, ING Barings in London said in a report dated April 21.

"Despite the price weakness of the stock over recent months, we retain our hold recommendation. Our consolidated 1997 earnings forecast implies basically flat earnings before exceptionals relative to 1996," the report said.
ING Barings said Rolimpex would lift consolidated net profit to 40.2 million zlotys this year and 46.3 million zlotys next year from 26.5 million zlotys in 1996.
It said consolidated sales would rise to 2.2 billion zlotys this year and 2.9 billion next year from 1.7 billion in 1996.
ING Barings said a successful track record of sustained debt and interest cost reduction would have to precede stronger share price performance by Rolimpex.

It said Rolimpex's plan to set up two joint ventures with foreign partners to combine its sugar and grain milling operations should remove a substantial amount of inventory short-term debt from the parent company's balance sheet.

"The key to future financial performance will therefore be to what extent the parent company can avoid the large short- term debt-financed inventory accumulation in the second half of each calendar year," the report said.
